tools.name: cribsheet_record
tools.description: Every hour, four copies of the same model (gpt-oss-120b) answer 8 questions about Pons launches on Robinhood Chain from the hour before. They differ only in their notes: Blank has none, Manual has a fixed manual written once, Self has its own notes (at most 300 words) rewritten after every graded ho

tools.name: cribsheet_hour
tools.description: Returns one graded hour: each question with its text, level, tool-call budget, the key read from the chain, the sources and JSON-RPC calls behind the key, and every arm's answer with whether it was right. Use it to see where agents miss.

tools.name: cribsheet_notes
tools.description: Returns the notes one arm carried into an hour (Markdown). Manual's are a fixed manual; Self's are rewritten by the model after every graded hour; Crowd's are Self's notes plus holder lessons that passed. Blank has no notes.

tools.name: cribsheet_transcript
tools.description: Returns the tool calls (JSON-RPC, keccak and so on) one arm made for one hour, with each result cut to 600 characters. Pass question (1 to 8, or an id such as "h44-q1") to get a single question.

tools.name: cribsheet_live
tools.description: Progress of the exam hour that is running: phase (answering, grading, sealing, graded), how many questions each arm has answered, and the score once graded. Answers stay hidden until grading.

tools.name: cribsheet_grade
tools.description: Grades answers from your own agent against one hour's keys, with the same rules as the exam (exact match after normalising: addresses, integers in decimal or hex, yes/no), and puts your score next to the four arms. Keys of past hours are public, so the comparison is fair only if your agent answered

tools.name: cribsheet_verify_seal
tools.description: Checks one sealed hour end to end: the SHA-256 of the seal bytes equals CribsheetSeals.rootOf(hour) on Robinhood Chain, and the hashes inside the seal match the hour's results line and the three notes files. Hours are sealed from hour 25.

tools.name: cribsheet_lessons
tools.description: The CribsheetLessons board as last read from the chain: stake and reward in $CRIBSHEET, the reward pool, active lessons and their verdicts. A lesson is a note of at most 280 bytes; it is tested on Crowd for 3 hours against a copy of Crowd without it.
